# Inkbar

> Inkbar is an open-source PDF viewer and editor for the browser, with form filling, highlights, note threads, drawing, signatures and redaction. It is written in TypeScript, has bindings for Vue, React and Svelte, and is free under the MIT licence.

- Install it from npm: `@inkbar/core` and `@inkbar/theme`, plus `@inkbar/vue`, `@inkbar/react` or `@inkbar/svelte`. The plain DOM API in `@inkbar/core/dom` needs no framework.
- Every editing tool is opt-in: pass the tool factories your toolbar offers as `tools`.
- Inkbar renders documents in the browser and sends them nowhere.

Start with the [Introduction](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs.md) and the [Quickstart](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/quickstart.md). Every page below links to its Markdown.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs.md): What Inkbar does today, what comes next, which packages it ships and where to start.
- [Quickstart](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/quickstart.md): Install Inkbar, add the Vite plugin and put a PDF on screen with a toolbar, in Vue, React, Svelte or with no framework.
- [Loading assets](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/loading-assets.md): Serve Inkbar's engine, fallback fonts and form script sandbox with the Vite plugin or from your own server.

## Guides

- [Toolbars](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/toolbars.md): Build toolbars from Inkbar's controls, place them where they fit your app, and swap in your own icons and labels.
- [Annotations](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/annotations.md): Which annotations Inkbar creates and displays, how to save them, how to follow changes and how the tools work from the keyboard.
- [Drawing](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/drawing.md): Draw freehand, add shapes, lines and text boxes, and set their colour, line style and text style from the toolbar or from code.
- [Search](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/search.md): Find text with the find bar or from code, read where each match sits on the page, and turn matches into a plugin's records.
- [Sidebars](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/sidebars.md): Put panels beside the pages, fill them with thumbnails, search results or your own markup, and list a plugin's records as cards.
- [Thumbnails](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/thumbnails.md): Draw pages as small images, list them as a page navigator, and use one thumbnail in a dialog or a card.
- [Outline and links](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/outline-and-links.md): Show the document's bookmarks as a tree, follow links on the page, handle web addresses in your app and add Back and Forward buttons.
- [Forms](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/forms.md): Fill AcroForm fields in the viewer, read and set values from code, handle what a form asks your app to do, and save values as Gloss.
- [Signatures](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/signatures.md): Let people draw, type or upload a signature, keep it for next time, and place it on the page or in a signature field.
- [Locked files](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/locked-files.md): Ask for the password of an encrypted PDF with the built-in dialog, replace the panel behind it, or run your own flow.
- [Redaction](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/redaction.md): Mark text and areas for redaction, then apply the marks to remove the content under them from the file.
- [Controlled mode](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/controlled-mode.md): Hold the annotation list in your own state and let Inkbar propose each change.
- [Plugins](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/plugins.md): Add a plugin to a viewer, place its commands and tools, load and save its records, and share undo with annotations.
- [Writing a plugin](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/writing-a-plugin.md): Write an Inkbar plugin with records, commands, marks and cards, once for every framework.
- [Saving](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/saving.md): Write annotations and form values into the PDF, so Download, Print and doc.save() give the file as it looks on screen.
- [Storage](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/storage.md): Choose where Inkbar keeps saved signatures, sidebar widths and plugin settings between visits, from memory to localStorage to your own server.
- [Theming](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/theming.md): Import Inkbar's default stylesheet, then restyle the PDF viewer with your own design tokens and CSS.
- [Translations](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/guides/translations.md): Show Inkbar in your own language with the French and German sets, override single strings, switch language live, and translate the labels you supply.

## Frameworks

- [Vue](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/frameworks/vue.md): Add a PDF viewer and editor to a Vue 3 app with Inkbar's components and composables: toolbars, annotations, forms and redaction.
- [React](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/frameworks/react.md): Add a PDF viewer and editor to a React 19 app with Inkbar's components and hooks: toolbars, annotations, forms and redaction.
- [Svelte](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/frameworks/svelte.md): Add a PDF viewer and editor to a Svelte 5 app with Inkbar's components and hooks: toolbars, annotations, forms and redaction.
- [Plain DOM](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/frameworks/plain-dom.md): Use Inkbar without a framework package, with createViewer and its toolbar controls, or mountViewer for your own chrome.

## Reference

- [Gloss format](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/reference/gloss.md): Inkbar exports and imports annotations as Gloss, an open JSON format for PDF annotations. What Inkbar adds, what it leaves out, and how to validate an export.
- [Theme tokens](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/reference/theme-tokens.md): The shadcn-compatible tokens and the annotation colour variables that Inkbar's stylesheet reads.
- [Icons](https://inkbar.dev/pr-preview/pr-84/docs/reference/icons.md): The 52 icons the toolbar controls show, which control shows each one, and how to use them on your own buttons.
